text:
Carla: Heads-up — HelixBank pilot kickoff tomorrow. Need alignment on acceptance criteria, golden prompts, security questionnaire status, and pricing for the trial. 6-week timeline. Can ML/DE help define seed set + scoring? cc @James @Matt @Nora

James: For pricing — we can do a 30-day pilot with usage caps (metered). Dedicated capacity is a separate quote. Carla, what's their expected qps / tokens/day?

Carla: They said ~200k tokens/day peak, mostly short prompts (<=256 tokens). Might ramp after week 3. Also flagged legal/Vendor Risk as blocker.

Matt: I'll own the eval harness. Can you share the top 3 user flows and 10 sample inputs so I can start building a seed+holdout split? My ask: ~200 golden prompts, 300 blind holdouts, and 100 fuzz cases.

Nora: Perf targets proposal: 200ms P95 for standard completions, 95th <= 300ms for bursts. Throughput target: sustain 50 reqs/s. Also want an automated fallback to smaller-model variant if SLO breached.

Tanya: Security checklist: they require EU data residency, logs access controls, and explicit guidance on PII handling. Vendor Risk form incomplete — I'll post the missing sections.

sec-bot: Vendor Risk form link: <https://redwood.internal/vendor-risk/helixbank> — outstanding: encryption at rest proof, SOC2 section, and data flow diagram.

Amy: Legal can approve DPA + EU addendum; will need the vendor risk answers and the list of subcontractors (CDN, observability).

Matt: Scoring rubric suggestion: weighted composite score. Quick example config I can wire into the harness:

```json
{
  "weights": {"semantic": 0.6, "hallucination_penalty": -0.2, "safety": 0.2},
  "pass_threshold": 0.85,
  "holdout_fraction": 0.3,
  "min_samples_per_case": 5
}
```

Matt: Implementation notes: semantic similarity = embedding cosine (we'll use cosine >= 0.72), hallucination penalty = heuristics + model answer overlap, safety = rule-based checks and LLM classifier.

Carla: Stakeholder asks a stricter regression gate: any drop >1.5% in overall composite score during rollout triggers pause & rollback. Is that feasible?

Nora: We can detect regressions nightly. Our baseline run after canary should set the baseline distribution. 1.5% is tight but doable with a well-curated goldenset. Recommend we hold out a small immutable goldenset for final gating.

James: Ops checklist: golden prompts must NOT contain PHI or customer secrets. We also need a synthetic traffic profile for batching tests — @Matt can you create a load script that simulates their token distribution?

Matt: Yep. Will produce a small kube job + sampling script. Also will add an automatic report: latency, cost/token, composite score per-run.

Tanya: Action on security — I'll complete vendor risk answers by EOD tomorrow, pinging infra for encryption proof.

Amy: Legal will review the vendor doc once Tanya posts. Expect 48-72h turnaround.

Carla: Quick success criteria summary (for HelixBank execs):
- Functional: >= 0.85 composite score on goldenset; no critical safety failures.
- Perf: 200ms P95 (<=300ms during bursts).
- Reliability: 99.5% uptime for pilot endpoints.
- Ops: nightly regression checks; rollback if composite drops >1.5%.
- Security: completed Vendor Risk + DPA signed; EU data residency.

Carla: Owners: Matt (eval harness + load script), Nora (prompt templates + goldenset curation), Tanya (vendor risk), Amy (legal sign-off), James (pricing & capacity quote).

James: One more pricing note — if they hit sustained >500k tokens/day during pilot, we should convert to a committed Dedicated quote, but leave a short opt-out window.

Nora: I'll upload initial 50 seed prompts by EOD to the shared drive and a template for reviewers.

Matt: I'll stub the harness repo, wire the scorer config, and open a PR with CI that runs the baseline. ETA: 48h.

Carla: Perfect. I'll include this summary in the kickoff and flag the outstanding vendor risk and timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:

(End thread)
